source.origin: Kieso et al. Intermediate Accounting 19e, ch.4 Balance Sheet and Statement of Cash Flows, Put It into Practice LO 4.2 part a (book p. 4-25..4-26), Cassy Corporation
source.ground_truth_provenance: textbook printed solution (Put It into Practice LO 4.2 part a, classified balance sheet)

prompt: 2028/12/31 の分類貸借対照表を作成せよ(流動資産は総資産への plug)。

map_note.CurrentAssets: Aggregation/classification caption (総称科目) summarizing several underlying current-asset ledger accounts (Cash, receivables, inventory, ...) that the source problem does not itemize (it is given as a plug); not itself a postable EA ledger account, so no valid constructor exists. Self-mapped for documentation only — this task has no journal component, so the EA oracle never needs to resolve it.
map_note.Equipment: No literal Equipment constructor; EA's elementary PP&E set is Building/Machinery/Vehicle/Fixtures. Aliased to Fixtures (備品) as the closest generic capital-equipment account, consistent with the same alias used in journalize-adjusting-entries-kieso-ch02-001.
map_note.AccumDepBuildings: EA's AccumulatedDepreciation constructor is generic (no per-asset-class subdivision). Aliased to AccumulatedDepreciation; collides with AccumDepEquipment below (same target). Accounting-review point.
map_note.AccumDepEquipment: Same generic-AccumulatedDepreciation collision as AccumDepBuildings above.
map_note.CurrentLiabilities: Aggregation/classification caption analogous to CurrentAssets above; not a postable EA account. Self-mapped for documentation only.
map_note.BondsPayable: No corporate-bonds-payable constructor; the only 'Bonds' constructors (LongTermNationalBonds/Payable) are scoped to government/SNA-macro bonds, not corporate debt. Aliased to LongTermLoansPayable (長期借入金, generic long-term debt) as the closest elementary-bookkeeping fit. Accounting-review point.
map_note.CommonStock: Aliased to CapitalStock (資本金) — clear naming translation, not a coverage gap.
map_note.LongTermInvestments: Aliased to InvestmentSecurities (投資有価証券) — reasonably clear naming translation for long-term investment holdings.
map_note.TreasuryStock: No treasury-stock (自己株式) contra-equity constructor exists in EA's Equity set. Self-mapped for documentation only, rather than forcing a misleading alias to an unrelated equity account; never enters journal scoring since this task has no journal component. Accounting-review point — candidate for future EA extension.

transactions_2028: 自己株式取得 13,200; 現金配当宣言・支払 36,000; 長期投資取得 19,200。
現金以外の流動資産 +34,800, 流動負債 +15,600。
建物増設 32,400; 特許償却 3,000; 設備(cost 24,000/accum 9,600)を 12,000 で売却。

expected_output.format_note: Return a single JSON object with one key "derived": a flat, dot-separated map of every numeric line on the classified 2028-12-31 balance sheet, covering both the "assets" section (e.g. "assets.TotalAssets") and the "liabilities_and_equity" section (e.g. "liabilities_and_equity.Total"), matching the ground_truth key names exactly.

review: 総資産 = 総負債+資本 = 661,200 の一致, 流動資産 355,800 を plug として導く妥当性(教科書が印刷値かを確認), 設備累計償却 ロールフォワード(13,200-9,600+10,800=14,400)。
confidence: high — 原本 PDF p.4-25/4-26 で突合・内部整合(B/S 661,200 で balance)確認。
